تضامنت (form VI)
# تَضَامَنْتُ (taḍāmantu) /ta.dˤaː.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
# تَضَامَنْتَ (taḍāmanta) /ta.dˤaː.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
# تَضَامَنْتِ (taḍāmanti) /ta.dˤaː.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
# تَضَامَنَتْ (taḍāmanat) /ta.dˤaː.ma.nat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
